summary.text: Russell Wyatt is an Undeclared candidate for Alaska House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the other candidate is incumbent Alyse Galvin (Nonpartisan).

paragraphs.text: Wyatt advanced from the August 18, 2026 primary for District 14 with 18.5 percent of the vote, finishing behind Galvin.
He previously ran for Alaska House of Representatives District 19, finishing second in the 2022 general election and third in the 2024 general election.
